description: claude-tooling: the shared checklist review gate, wired for Codex. Managed by `claude-tooling init --codex`; re-trust in /hooks after a re-render.

A gate whose binary is missing blocks only calls that may need it (commits, gh pr create or merge in any spelling, anything touching .claude/reviews), and a Stop check whose binary is missing is skipped. To repair, run `agent-gate setup . --kind software` from the repository root. Then start a new session to run this hook.", "hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "codex-guidance-inject: there is no .venv/bin/codex-guidance-inject in this repository or in its main checkout, so this session-start hook did not run. A gate whose binary is missing blocks only calls that may need it (commits, gh pr create or merge in any spelling, anything touching .claude/reviews), and a Stop check whose binary is missing is skipped. To repair, run `agent-gate setup . --kind software` from the repository root. Then start a new session to run this hook."}}'; exit 0

R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); G="$R/.venv/bin/codex-review-gate"; if [ ! -x "$G" ]; then M=$(git -C "$R" rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); case "$M" in /*) G="${M%/.git}/.venv/bin/codex-review-gate";; esac; fi; if [ -x "$G" ]; then exec "$G"; fi; P=$(sed -E 's/"(cwd|transcript_path|description)": *"([^"\\]|\\.)*"//g'); case "$P" in *commit*|*gh*pr*create*|*gh*pr*merge*|*.claude/reviews*) printf '%s\n' 'codex-review-gate: there is no .venv/bin/codex-review-gate in this repository or in its main checkout, so this command is blocked: it mentions commit, .claude/reviews, or gh with pr create or pr merge, which need the gate. Other commands still run. To repair, run `agent-gate setup . --kind software` from the repository root. Then retry.' >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0

R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); G="$R/.venv/bin/codex-protect-verdict"; if [ ! -x "$G" ]; then M=$(git -C "$R" rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); case "$M" in /*) G="${M%/.git}/.venv/bin/codex-protect-verdict";; esac; fi; if [ -x "$G" ]; then exec "$G"; fi; P=$(grep -oE '"(file_path|notebook_path|path)": *"([^"\\]|\\.)*"|\*\*\* (Add File|Update File|Delete File|Move to): ([^"\\]|\\[^n])*'); case "$P" in *.claude/reviews*) printf '%s\n' 'codex-protect-verdict: there is no .venv/bin/codex-protect-verdict in this repository or in its main checkout, so this write into .claude/reviews, which the verdict guard protects, is blocked.
